about: Notes of every part of the cleaned sneaky set, on the set clock (bar 0 starts at 0 s; the song's first downbeat is bar 1). t = seconds in the stem files, beat = beats from bar 0, bar = bar number, pitch = MIDI note, len = seconds. Band parts: Suno's MIDI of each stem (drums include the percussion stem, strings include the synth stem, as the set folds them). Voices: each sung syllable from the score, on the beat it is sung to. loop: play bar 0 once (the pickup), then loop start_s to end_s (bars 1-34); notes after end_s are the last notes ringing out. compact: {part: [[t, pitch, len], ...]}.
